paragraphs.text: Pontotoc City School District has announced a $51,000 grant from the Toyota Wellspring Education Fund through CREATE Foundation. The announcement was shared Friday morning by Pontotoc Athletics, with the district saying the funding will support learning and expand educational opportunities across its schools.

A photograph accompanying the announcement shows a ceremonial check made out to Pontotoc City Schools for $51,000 and dated Oct. 22, 2026. The district’s notice does not identify a specific purchase or spending timetable. The full announcement and check photograph are linked below.
